## ctxloom remote browse

Browse bundles in a remote

### Synopsis

List bundles available in a remote repository.

Examples:
  ctxloom remote browse ctxloom-default

```
ctxloom remote browse <remote> [flags]
```

  -r, --recursive   List items in subdirectories (default true)
